title: Generative AI-driven de novo design of high-affinity, epitope-specific antibodies targeting the CD93-IGFBP7 axis for cancer immunotherapy.
summary: Generative AI contributed a candidate antibody that showed measured target binding/blockade and tumor-model activity; the evidence is preclinical and does not establish human efficacy.
